item.title: Train Sim World 6 to soon have its first Czechia route
item.description: 10th March will be a momentous time for Train Sim World 6 with the release of trains and challenges in Czechia, formerly the Czech Republic.

item.title: High Wycombe welcomes 2026 model railway exhibition this April
item.description: The High Wycombe and District Model Railway Society will celebrate the art of railway modelling at its annual MRX26 exhibition on Saturday, 11th April.

item.title: ÖBB Rail Cargo Group reports positive Digital Automatic Coupling (DAC) tests
item.description: The ÖBB Rail Cargo Group has revealed that winter testing, using a demo train, has confirmed that Digital Automatic Coupling is highly robust.

item.title: Alresford Station volunteer gardeners celebrated with RHS award
item.description: Volunteers who care for Alresford railway station have been recognised at the Royal Horticultural Society Community Awards 2025 for their work transforming the station into a vibrant green space.

item.title: East Anglia passengers asked to plan ahead for travel
item.description: Passengers travelling across East Anglia this Easter are being asked to check before travel during periods of service disruption. London Liverpool Street station will remain fully operational throughout the long bank holiday, with Greater Anglia trains serving destinations including Southend Victoria, Chelmsford, Colchester, Ipswich, and Norwich.

item.title: Greater Anglia launches online tour of Beaulieu Park station
item.description: Train operator Greater Anglia has launched an online virtual tour of Beaulieu Park railway station to help passengers plan journeys and travel with greater confidence. The 360-degree tour allows users to explore the station before they arrive, helping them understand how to move around the site and locate key facilities.

item.title: Passengers reminded of changes to service on the East Coast Mainline
item.description: Passengers are being advised of significant travel disruptions on the East Coast Main Line south of Peterborough on Sunday, 15 March, due to further testing of a new digital signalling system.

item.title: Glasgow Central station closed and trains suspended due to vape shop fire
item.description: Network Rail has confirmed that Glasgow Central Station has been closed due to a fire at a vape shop near the station.
